keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Fabrício Bruno (Cruzeiro).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cruzeiro. Matías Viña replaces Fabrício Bruno because of an injury.
Nicolás Acevedo (Bahia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Cruzeiro 0, Bahia 1. Cristian Olivera (Bahia) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the top right corner. Assisted by Rodrigo Nestor with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Cruzeiro 1, Bahia 1. Kaio Jorge (Cruzeiro) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Keny Arroyo.
First Half ends, Cruzeiro 1, Bahia 1.
Second Half begins Cruzeiro 1, Bahia 1.
Substitution, Bahia. Jean Lucas replaces Nicolás Acevedo.
Penalty missed. Kaio Jorge (Cruzeiro) right footed shot is too high.
Substitution, Bahia. Caio Alexandre replaces Erick.
Substitution, Bahia. Michel Araújo replaces Rodrigo Nestor.
Substitution, Bahia. Erick Pulga replaces Éverton Ribeiro.
Goal! Cruzeiro 2, Bahia 1. Bruno Rodrigues (Cruzeiro) header from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Keny Arroyo following a fast break.
Caio Alexandre (Bahia) Yellow Card at 69'
Bruno Rodrigues (Cruzeiro) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Jonathan Jesus (Cruzeiro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Cruzeiro. Marquinhos replaces Keny Arroyo.
Substitution, Cruzeiro. Kauã Moraes replaces Fágner.
Substitution, Cruzeiro. Matheus Henrique replaces Bruno Rodrigues.
Substitution, Bahia. Román Gómez replaces Kanu.
Goal! Cruzeiro 3, Bahia 1. Kaio Jorge (Cruzeiro) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lucas Romero.
Substitution, Cruzeiro. Lucas Silva replaces Gerson.
